prompt:
Generate one finished Korean blog cover, square. name: section1

prompt: Finished explanatory Korean editorial diagram, landscape 3:2. A realistic rainbow landscape photo on the left, a technical conceptual cutaway of its image data on the right, connected by dotted zoom connector, NOT causal arrow. Slate dark navy backdrop and sharp sky blue/white elements, photographic landscape texture, restrained visual design. Only exact large Korean labels '눈으로 보는 사진' on left and '보이지 않는 AI 표식' on right and '개념도' small but readable lower corner. The cutaway has a subtle abstract fingerprint signal, clearly an educational conceptual visualization, not real detected watermark or official screen. No logo overlay on photo, no model scores or percentages. Distinct from pastel infographic and prior general office scenes. Accurate clean typography and large mobile readable labels.

name: section2
explains: Detector와 Gemini의 SynthID 감지 범위 차이
alt: Detector는 Google와 협력사 범위이고 Gemini는 현재 Google AI 범위라는 두 칸 비교 도해
prompt: Korean explanatory two-column diagram, landscape 3:2, clean off-white background, burgundy/coral left panel and royal blue right panel, strong black typography. Top heading exact '같은 표식, 다른 확인 범위'. LEFT exact large heading 'SynthID Detector', labels 'Google · OpenAI', 'NVIDIA · Kakao', separate bottom chip 'Apple은 향후'. RIGHT exact large heading 'Gemini', central big label '현재 Google AI'. Bottom exact 'SynthID 표식의 지원 범위 비교'. Visuals: left several source photo cards converge on a magnifier, right one Google AI label card toward a magnifier. Use no trademarks or official logos, no fake screenshot, no unsupported all-media guarantee. Source lanes comparison is conceptual, no accuracy numbers. All Korean spelling accurate, mobile legible and uncropped.

name: section3
explains: 같은 사진에 붙은 오늘이라는 설명과 과거 날짜는 별도로 대조해야 함
alt: 동일한 무지개 사진 옆의 오늘이라는 설명과 이전 게시 날짜를 대조하는 가정 예시 사진
prompt: Create one photorealistic Korean editorial illustration photograph landscape 3:2, medium-wide overhead camera, sunlight over a broad light oak reading table, entire two printouts visible. Two identical realistic rainbow landscape photographs on paper placed side by side. Left printed sheet has exact large headline '오늘 우리 동네?' above rainbow photo. Right sheet has exact large headline '이전 게시물' above the same rainbow image, a large generic calendar icon below. A hand with pencil simply connecting the two matching photos, no identifiable person. Top left margin small clear label '가정 예시'. Natural materials, crisp natural photography, rich sunshine and shadows, no fake official service UI, no browser, no laptops, no invented real website or actual date, no additional text. The visually obvious action is comparing the same picture with an earlier publication, not proving AI generation. Different from diagrams, older flower/theatre/workshop scenes. Text clear and uncut.

name: section4
explains: 공유 판단은 표식 결과와 출처·날짜 대조를 함께 거침
alt: 파일 준비에서 표식 확인과 출처 날짜 비교를 거쳐 공유 판단으로 이어지는 도해
prompt: Finished Korean editorial process illustration landscape 3:2, flat cut-paper collage mixed realistic photograph texture, pale lilac background, deep purple ink, simple four large horizontal panels. Exact title '공유 전에 두 가지 질문'. First pair panels heading 'AI 표식은?' with photograph-to-magnifier icon, second pair heading '출처·날짜는?' with same photograph and calendar/source-page icons. Bottom large exact conclusion '불명확하면 공유 보류'. No false verified badge, no fake tool UI, no logo, no numeric score. Small source pages are conceptual blank lines rather than invented facts. Visually both questions converge on human sharing decision with two clearly directed arrows, no implication the service automatically verifies a true event. Mobile typography prominent, no tiny captions, generous whitespace, all labels fully visible.

AI 표식 확인', magnifier over rainbow photo icon; next panel exact '2. 출처·날짜 대조', source page and calendar icon; connecting arrow means reader action sequence. Middle two side-by-side comparison mini-panels with exact labels 'Detector' and 'Google · 협력사' left, 'Gemini' and '현재 Google AI' right. Bottom huge yellow marker emphasized statement exact '미검출 ≠ 진짜 인증', below exact '불명확하면 공유 보류'.
